name: extension
description: Encrypted developer chat inside VS Code

commands.title: Dev Chat: Host Relay on This Network
Dev Chat: Regenerate Hosted Relay Certificate
Dev Chat: Review Contact Key Changes

devChat.relayUrl.patternErrorMessage: Relay URL must start with wss:// (or ws:// for a relay on this computer)
devChat.relayUrl.markdownDescription: Address of the relay to connect to, for example `wss://192.168.1.20:8787#sha256=AB:CD:...`. Paste the full address the relay host shares with you: the `#sha256=` part pins the relay's certificate so nobody can impersonate it. Unencrypted `ws://` is only allowed for a relay on this computer. Ignored while you are hosting a relay with **Dev Chat: Host Relay on This Network**.

devChat.hostRelay.port.markdownDescription: Port used by **Dev Chat: Host Relay on This Network**. Change it if another program already uses the default port.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm --prefix ../server run build && node --test
